## Professional experience

<div class="entry-dates">Jul 2026 – present</div>
<div class="entry-body">
### Postdoctoral Researcher
<div class="entry-org">Université Paris-Est Créteil, France</div>
<ul>
<li>High-precision gait mode recognition with LSTM networks (98% accuracy) for real-time intent detection on actuated ankle-foot orthoses.</li>
<li>Energy-efficient adaptive FES control from surface EMG — 30% lower stimulation energy, reduced muscle fatigue in clinical trials.</li>
<li>Multi-sensor fusion (7 IMUs) for lower-limb kinematics and Parkinson's disease assessment in a portable clinical device.</li>
</ul>
</div>
